title: Planning checks a guard's detector against the acceptor it guards, on planted variants, not only the clean form
goal: kb/_self/backlog.md (Sprints: plan) and the sprint skill say that an item adding a guard in front of an acceptor (a refusal keyed on a text the acceptor reads, such as kbdecide.py's ceiling guard in front of tests.py read_ceiling) carries a check that runs the acceptor's own predicate and the guard on planted variants (a prefix, a suffix, case), so a guard narrower than its acceptor fails before the start; a tested _self question leads rag.py pack --root _self to the rule
notes: Merged from ST-4yrugqfu “An item that widens a parser or matcher carries a check that an input outside its target is unchanged” at the 2026-10-13 draft triage: Planning-rule prose; it asks for the same planted-variant check as ST-ilzaoi32 (negative input of a widened parser vs a guard on planted variants). Both fixes are one edit to the kb-sprint plan step and kb/_self/backlog.md. Three regressions are behind it (BG-bvyblfnp, BG-676tplds, BG-apytw7fo) but review catches each. Its goal: SP-5i4itd2d retrospective: two items' checks passed on work that regressed inputs outside their goal: ST-z5uh6oj7's VERSION_ID read a SID's digits as a version (BG-bvyblfnp) and ST-vlkxprhy's range clamp stopped refusing a citation far past a file's end (BG-676tplds); each check planted only the target input. Planning (kb-sprint plan step 6) names, for a committed item that widens a tokenizer, regex or citation parser, one negative check of an input the change must leave as it was, as it already does for attribution rules. Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','what negative check does an item that widens a parser carry','--budget','300'],capture_output=True,text=True);o=r.stdout;h=o.splitlines()[0] if o else '';print(h or r.stderr[:200]);sys.exit(r.returncode or int(not h.startswith('coverage: good (tested question')))"]} Its touches: .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md, kb/_self/backlog.md Merged from ST-xcttbexh at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (item in git history): Its rule (the check runs the real guard unstubbed on planted variants) is ST-ilzaoi32's rule; the concrete defect it cites is BG-4lxb2w34. It must also absorb the new check warning: a code item whose touches name a test file that its checks select no test of (bl_check has only the reverse, named_test_file_warnings).
